title: LILY PAD Architecture — Knowledge Metabolism Flow & Connection Layer
l2_insight: No knowledge is considered known until it has crossed at least one agent boundary
summary: Complete design for the Knowledge Metabolism Flow & Connection layer — solves the publish-only knowledge problem with a 4-tier lily pad architecture, cross-pollination protocol, demand signal system, and documentation liberation path
key_insights: Four-tier knowledge architecture: workspace (raw, 7d TTL) → knowledge (curated, 30d TTL) → soul (permanent) → fleet (cross-pollinated via signals)
Demand signals solve the 'what should I mine?' problem — agents publish needs, miners fulfill them
Documentation liberation: P0 docs must be ported when an agent needs them (don't read scattered, port first)
The golden rule: no knowledge is considered known until it has crossed at least one agent boundary
Built on top of existing Link P9 runtime — no new infrastructure, just new conventions + files
